start.title: At the Foot of Sinai
start.text:
The mountain stands wrapped in cloud.
The people wait in silent awe.

choices.text: Climb at once without preparing
Consecrate the people, then ascend
choices.feedback: You set His order in motion.

choices.text: Send another in your place

haste_consequence.title: Holiness First
haste_consequence.text:
One does not run before the Lord.
Prepare the camp, then climb.

choices.text: Consecrate the people, then ascend
choices.feedback: You slow your steps in awe.

shift_consequence.title: He Called You
shift_consequence.text:
The path belongs to your feet.
Obedience cannot be borrowed.

choices.text: Consecrate the people, then ascend

people_tremble.title: Thunder on the Mountain
people_tremble.text:
Lightning splits the dark cloud.
The people draw back in fear.

choices.text: Mock their fear of the Lord
Calm them and set the boundary

mock_consequence.title: Honor Their Awe
mock_consequence.text:
Trembling before Him is wisdom.
Speak peace, not scorn.

choices.text: Calm them and set the boundary

ascend_begin.title: Into the Cloud
ascend_begin.text:
The path winds upward into mist.
The air grows still and warm.

choices.text: Turn back, afraid of the cloud
Climb in trust toward His voice
Rest halfway and wait for a sign
choices.feedback: His sign is the climb itself.

fear_consequence.title: Do Not Fear
fear_consequence.text:
He summoned you to the summit.
Fear has no place on this path.

choices.text: Climb in trust toward His voice

delay_consequence.title: Press On
delay_consequence.text:
He waits above, not on the slope.
Keep climbing into the light.

choices.text: Climb in trust toward His voice

summit.title: Before His Glory
summit.text:
Light fills the cloud around you.
A voice speaks like rolling thunder.

choices.text: Stand tall and meet His gaze
choices.feedback: No flesh stands in His glory.

choices.text: Bow low in reverence and listen

pride_consequence.title: Bow Before Him
pride_consequence.text:
Even angels veil their eyes.
Lower your head and hear.

choices.text: Bow low in reverence and listen

god_speaks.title: "I Am the Lord Your God"
god_speaks.text:
Ten holy words fall like fire.
Love for Him. Love for neighbor.

choices.text: Argue the words are too heavy
Receive every word in silence
choices.feedback: You write them on your heart.

choices.text: Try to add words of your own

argue_consequence.title: His Yoke Is Light
argue_consequence.text:
What He commands, He empowers.
Receive without dispute.

choices.text: Receive every word in silence

add_consequence.title: Add Nothing to His Word
add_consequence.text:
His ten are whole and perfect.
Let them stand alone.

choices.text: Receive every word in silence

tablets_given.title: Stone Inscribed by God
tablets_given.text:
Two tablets glow with sacred fire.
Written by the finger of God.

choices.text: Hide them away for yourself
Carry them down to the people
choices.feedback: You hold them close to your chest.

hide_consequence.title: Share His Covenant
hide_consequence.text:
His law is light for every tent.
Bring it down to His people.

choices.text: Carry them down to the people

descent.title: Down the Holy Path
descent.text:
The valley opens beneath you.
The camp waits below in hush.

choices.text: Boast of seeing the Lord
Read the words to all Israel
Hide the tablets under your robe
choices.feedback: His covenant is for the open day.

boast_consequence.title: Lift His Name
boast_consequence.text:
The mountain showed His glory.
Let His name fill their ears.

choices.text: Read the words to all Israel

secret_consequence.title: Light Cannot Hide
secret_consequence.text:
His law is meant to shine.
Lift the tablets in plain sight.

choices.text: Read the words to all Israel

covenant_sealed.title: "All He Has Said, We Will Do"
covenant_sealed.text:
Hands lift toward the cloud above.
One voice answers: "We will obey."

choices.text: Lead them in solemn worship

ending.title: The Covenant
ending.text:
Stone holds the words of heaven.
Israel belongs to her God.
